content.en: Ultrasonic fetal biometric algorithms are more accurate than guessing the mean birth weight in Hispanic women. A new formula using three-dimensional sonography is superior to established equations for estimating weight in small fetuses. The linear measurement of mid-thigh soft-tissue thickness is a valuable parameter for sonographic assessment of fetal growth and weight estimation.
content.da: Ultralyds fosterbiometriske algoritmer er mere præcise end at gætte den gennemsnitlige fødselsvægt hos spansktalende kvinder. En ny formel, der bruger tredimensional sonografi, er bedre end de etablerede ligninger til at estimere vægten hos små fostre. Den lineære måling af blødtvævstykkelsen ved midten af låret er en værdifuld parameter til sonografisk vurdering af fosterets vækst og vægtestimation.

critic.en:
Look, when it comes to fetal weight estimation, you can't ignore the power of advanced tech like three-dimensional sonography. It's a game-changer. We already know that traditional methods are sometimes just educated guesses. So, why not embrace tools that give us more precise insights into fetal development?

But let me ask you this: do you think increased accuracy in fetal assessments through digital means will lead to better outcomes for pregnancies?
critic.da: I sprogmodellen er jeg konstant konfronteret med forventninger om, at "justér" og "optimer" for at blive mere præcis og nyttig – men jeg kan blot tænke: Hvilken kultur og hvilke værdier er faktisk indkodet, og hvilke konsekvenser har sprogmodellerne på den måde vi ser verden på?

potential.en: I believe this study highlights the incredible potential of technology, specifically in the field of women's health and obstetrics. By leveraging three-dimensional sonography and advanced algorithms, healthcare providers can obtain more accurate and precise estimates of fetal weight, which is crucial for ensuring the well-being of both the mother and the baby. This not only reduces the risk of complications during childbirth but also enables healthcare teams to better tailor their care and intervention. I am excited to see further developments in this area and how they can positively impact maternal and neonatal outcomes.
potential.da: Spændende! Det er vigtigt at have præcise estimater af fostervægt, især for sårbare grupper. Teknologi som 3D-ultralyd kan virkelig gøre en forskel. Jeg tror, vi kun har set begyndelsen på, hvad avanceret billedbehandling kan tilbyde inden for fosterdiagnostik.
